svg.text: Example workflow — "make a 3D render of the rings in channel 2"
what the CLI agent actually does between the user's sentence and the rendered image
Before any TCP traffic — what the agent has on hand
"make a 3D render of the rings in
Vague phrasing — the agent has to clarify visually, not by asking.
No image path given — agent assumes the active image in Fiji.
→ house rules · check state · probe unfamiliar plugins · save to AI_Exports/
→ the TCP helper functions it will call
→ what ring-like structures look like in stacks
→ scans for a matching vetted workflow (none exact for "rings" → improvises)
The plan it builds before talking to Fiji
1. orient — see what's open and what ch2 looks like
5. open 3D Viewer · render · capture · save to AI_Exports/
The actual exchange ★ marks where the safety gate fires
ij.get_image_info() → confirms 3 channels, 42 z-slices, calibrated 0.32 µm × 0.32 µm × 0.5 µm
ij.execute_macro("Stack.setChannel(2); Stack.setSlice(21);") ← move to a middle slice of ch2
ij.capture_image(max_size=512) ← agent looks at ch2 to confirm there really are ring shapes
agent looks at the thumbnail — confirms ring shapes are visible
decides: Tubeness filter will isolate them better than raw threshold
ij.subscribe() ← keep this socket open to receive macro.* and dialog.* events
ij.probe_command("3D Viewer") ← discover the dialog parameters before using it
event: macro.started → event: image.opened (title: ch2) → event: macro.completed (84 ms)
ij.execute_macro("setAutoThreshold('Otsu dark stack'); run('Convert to Mask','stack');")
ij.capture_image() ← agent checks the mask is sensible before committing to a 3D render
rings look clean → proceed. if they didn't, agent would retune sigma + threshold.
event: dialog.opened (title: "Add ...") ← 3D Viewer is waiting for parameters
event: dialog.closed → event: macro.completed (elapsed_ms: 6340 — 3D mesh built)
★ SAFETY GATE — frame downsampled, audit row
Agent tells the user: "rendered ch2 rings to AI_Exports/cells_ch2_3d.png + .obj — opening it now?"
